description_en: Queries the auto-whitelist rules for security alerts
description_zh: 查询告警自动加白规则
name: DescribeSecurityEventMarkMissList

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The asset search keyword. You can enter the IP address, public IP address, private IP address, or asset name for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 资产检索项。可填写资产的IP、公网IP、内网IP、资产名称进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of whitelist rules to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that 20 whitelist rules are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的白名单规则数量。默认值为**20**，表示每页显示20条白名单规则
parameters.name: page_size
